description.p: CouchPlay enables local split-screen multiplayer gaming on Linux by running multiple gamescope instances simultaneously. Each player gets their own isolated Steam instance with dedicated input devices.

ul.li: Run 2-4 simultaneous gamescope/Steam instances
Automatic input device detection and assignment
Flexible screen layout configuration (split horizontally, vertically, or custom)
Per-user Steam configurations and save games
Save and load session profiles for quick setup
Create desktop shortcuts for one-click game launching

description.p: Perfect for couch gaming with friends and family on a single PC with multiple controllers.
Feature release: SteamOS support, Flatpak-first install, and cross-distro hardening

ul.li: Flatpak is now the default GUI install (works on every distro); the one-liner installs the Flatpak GUI + helper
SteamOS support: systemd-sysext helper images + Game Mode launcher
Steam Controller support + multi-device controller grouping (DualSense, Steam Controller)
Input-device watching moved into the root helper for reliable device attribution
Non-systemd init support (OpenRC/Artix, runit); the helper D-Bus-activates without a systemd unit
Fix copy-relocation startup failure on Arch/SteamOS (helper libs bundled)
Fix Flatpak /etc isolation; host user/device identity routed through the helper
Fix user creation on Bazzite (missing input group)
Fix PlayStation controller detection + vendor/product parsing
Sunshine-based streaming for split-screen sessions
Controller exit chord (Start+Select) to stop a session
Make PolkitQt6-1 a required CMake dependency to prevent silent build failures
Implement Polkit authorization for CreateUser/DeleteUser
Fix device assignment cache in autoAssignControllers and unassignAll
Fix audio runtime access tracking on TCP listener teardown
Fix borderlessWindows setting persistence and default to true
Fix cross-user audio routing via PipeWire PulseAudio TCP listener
Fix version display in settings (was hardcoded)
Fix missing app icon when installed via one-liner
Remove redundant helper version D-Bus method
Add grid sub-layouts for 3 players
Sequential instance launching for better resource management
Screensaver inhibition during active sessions
Replace machinectl with systemd-run transient units
Improved page navigation and audio routing
Basic session management
Input device detection and assignment
Monitor layout configuration
Profile save/load functionality
